response.sql:
WITH site_totals AS (
  SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) AS artifact_count
  FROM scanfeatures
  GROUP BY zoneref
), shares AS (
  SELECT zoneref, artifact_count,
         artifact_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(articount) FROM scanfeatures) AS share
  FROM site_totals
), scored AS (
  SELECT zoneref, artifact_count, share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average
  FROM shares
  WHERE (SELECT SUM(articount) FROM scanfeatures) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT zoneref, artifact_count, share, share_minus_average
FROM scored
WHERE (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A site with feature records whose artifact counts are all NULL is retained with a NULL site total and share; SQLite ignores those NULL shares when computing the average.
